_comment: Generated props placed into the Island map by Scripts/Place-IslandProps.py. Use asset_path for any imported StaticMesh object path; legacy asset = folder name under /Game/Generated/Tripo still works. x, y in cm; z is dropped onto the ground and z_offset adds to it; yaw in degrees. Runs preview by default; PLACE_PROPS_APPLY=1 updates/adds only configured IDs, leaves other managed actors untouched, and saves. PLACE_PROPS_DRYRUN=1 always forces preview-only behavior.
